text: SELECT md.chembl_id AS chembl_id, md.pref_name AS name, cs.canonical_smiles AS structure, di.mesh_heading AS indication_mesh_heading, di.efo_term AS indication_efo_term FROM molecule_dictionary md INNER JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno INNER JOIN drug_indication di ON md.molregno = di.molregno WHERE md.therapeutic_flag = 1 AND (LOWER(di.mesh_heading) = 'diabetes mellitus, type 2' OR LOWER(di.efo_term) = 'type 2 diabetes mellitus') ORDER BY md.pref_name ASC;
